Bullying · TVC
Unshareable Stories · Bullying
"Kids shouldn't have unshareable stories about bullying."

A schoolyard. A dropped notebook. A moment of cruelty so ordinary it almost looks invisible. That's what makes it cut through. BGC Clubs give kids a place to share what they can't say anywhere else — and the support to change what comes next.

Watch the film →
Hunger · TVC
Unshareable Stories · Hunger
"Kids shouldn't have unshareable stories about hunger."

A school lunch line. A locker. A lie a child tells every day because hunger carries shame. BGC Clubs provide nearly 6 million meals and snacks annually — because a kid who's hungry can't learn, grow, or share what they're carrying.
